manifest.name: @blksword/dsh-flowus
manifest.description: FlowUs for DeepSeek Harness: browser OAuth sign-in against the official FlowUs MCP server, its tools registered as native agent tools, a /flowus command, and a Settings -> FlowUs page.
manifest.author: BlkSword <wfshenm@qq.com>

bundle.text:
# @blksword/dsh-flowus bundle layer.
#
# One plugin row. `name` must be the FULL package specifier as installed in the
# profile's node_modules: the loader imports it as a module, so a bare
# `dsh-flowus` here fails to resolve (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND). Quote the value —
# a YAML scalar starting with `@` is an indicator and fails to parse.
#
# Config defaults already point at the official endpoint
# (https://mcp.flowus.cn/message); the block below is the explicit, editable
# copy so a user can see and change every switch from the profile layer.
- insert:
    - id: flowus
      name: "@blksword/dsh-flowus"
      config:
        serverUrl: "https://mcp.flowus.cn/message"
        serverName: "flowus"
        scope: "all"
        autoConnect: true

readme.text:
[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 FlowUs 集成插件。该插件在宿主进程内完成面向 FlowUs 官方 MCP 服务器（`https://mcp.flowus.cn/message`）的 OAuth 2.1 授权（RFC 9728 元数据发现、RFC 7591 动态客户端注册、PKCE S256），将服务器公布的工具注册为 Agent 原生工具，并提供 `/flowus` 命令与设置面板页面。授权过程不使用静态令牌。

- **浏览器授权。** 面向 FlowUs 官方 MCP 服务器完成 OAuth 2.1 授权码流程，回调地址为 `127.0.0.1` 上的 loopback 监听。访问令牌与刷新令牌保存在插件私有状态文件中，由插件自动续期。
- **原生工具。** 将 FlowUs MCP 服务器公布的工具注册至 DSH 工具注册表，命名规则与 DSH 内置 MCP 桥一致，即 `mcp__flowus__<工具名>`。
- **`/flowus` 命令。** 提供状态查询、授权、登出、工具列表、直接调用、重连与帮助。
- **设置面板页面。** 设置面板中的独立 FlowUs 页面：授权与连接状态、服务器版本、工具目录（可按名称或描述搜索，并标注只读/写入），以及授权、重连、登出、刷新操作；凭据路径与授权地址可一键复制，登录等待期间自动轮询，切回标签页时立即刷新。
- **系统提示词段落。** 将服务器 instructions 与当前工具目录并入系统提示词；未授权时给出明确的操作指引。
DSH 内置的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 支持 `stdio` 与 `streamable-http`（自定义请求头）两种接入方式，不支持 MCP OAuth。FlowUs 官方 MCP 服务器采用 OAuth 2.1，并要求客户端在无法完成授权流程时明确报告，而非退回静态令牌。本插件实现该 OAuth 客户端流程，并将发现的工具桥接至 `ctx.tools`。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @blksword/dsh-flowus@latest
```

`dsh plugin add` 的执行过程如下：

1. 通过 pnpm 安装该包；
2. 识别包内声明的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并将 `@blksword/dsh-flowus` 追加至 `dsh.profile.bundles`（无需手工编辑 `package.json`）；
3. 通过 peer 依赖解析到 DSH 安装内提供的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 实现。

pnpm 11 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 默认值为 1440 分钟：发布不足 24 小时的版本在解析 `@latest` 时会被跳过，解析结果回退至上一版本，且退出码仍为成功。安装最新发布时应指定确切版本号：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @blksword/dsh-flowus@0.1.1
```

仓库为公开仓库，可不经 registry 直接安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:BlkSword/dsh-flowus
```

该路径已完成端到端验证：pnpm 可解析 git 依赖，bundle 条目写入 `dsh.profile.bundles`，加载器完成组合与导入（`dsh --profile <名称> --dump-config` 与 `--dump-config-schema` 均通过）。如需可复现的安装，可使用 `github:BlkSword/dsh-flowus#<commit-sha>` 指定提交；后续通过 `dsh plugin --profile web update @blksword/dsh-flowus` 获取更新。
```powershell
npm pack --pack-destination "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web"

readme.section: 2. 在 profile 目录中安装（使用相对路径）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:./blksword-dsh-flowus-0.1.1.tgz"
```

> Windows 说明：pnpm 会将 `link:D:/...`、`file:D:/...` 形式的绝对路径按相对路径解析，从而生成指向 `...\profiles\web\D:\...` 的无效链接。因此应先将 tarball 打包至 profile 目录，再使用上述相对 `file:` 说明符。
重启 `dsh web` 并刷新浏览器页面。客户端入口图（`window.__DSH_BOOT__`）在进程启动时组装，默认配置下 `dsh-hmr` 的 `root: []` 仅保留显式配置监视点，因此新增插件不会热加载进正在运行的进程。重启后可通过 `/flowus status` 或“设置 → FlowUs”确认加载结果。

本版本支持的 DSH 版本为 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-alpha.1`、`0.2.1-alpha.2`，不支持其他版本。peer 依赖与兼容性记录仅声明这三个版本。

| DSH 版本 | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | `~4.0.4` | `~3.18.4` |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | `~4.0.5-alpha.1` | `~3.18.5-alpha.1` |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2` | `~4.0.5-alpha.1` | `~3.18.5-alpha.1` |

peer 依赖声明方式：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 采用精确版本析取 `0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-alpha.1 || 0.2.1-alpha.2`；`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 与 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 采用成对范围 `~4.0.4 || ~4.0.5-alpha.1` 与 `~3.18.4 || ~3.18.5-alpha.1`。上述 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包均由当前 dsh profile 提供，不应另行添加依赖。

该矩阵经实测确认：离线套件与联网冒烟测试分别在三个运行时自带的包上执行，均无失败；插件涉及的具名导出集合在三个版本间完全一致。alpha 版本的范围分支为必需项：预发布版本仅在比较符于同一 `major.minor.patch` 上带预发布标识时才满足范围，因此 `~4.0.4` 不接受 `4.0.5-alpha.1`，`0.2.0-rc.2` 亦不接受 `0.2.1-alpha.1`。
**未列入声明的新版本（实测记录）。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.3` 与 `alpha.4` 已发布，本插件暂不声明支持：

- **宿主半层已在 alpha.3 上实测通过。** 在一份完整安装的 alpha.3 运行时（609 个包，peer 闭包齐全）上运行本仓库全部用例：164 项、161 通过、0 失败、3 项联网跳过，与 `0.2.0-rc.2` 结果一致。该运行时配对的 `cordis@4.0.5-alpha.2`、`schemastery@3.18.5-alpha.2`、`dsh-tools@0.2.1-alpha.3` 均落在现有 `~` 与精确析取范围内，无需修改声明。
- **客户端半层尚未验证。** alpha 线不再把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 作为运行时的依赖包（`node_modules\@deepseek-ai` 下已无此包），而设置页的 classic script 需要从 shell 的模块表 `require` 它；alpha.3 的 shell bundle 中仍可见该模块 id，故结论未定。列入支持前，需要在 alpha.3 上真正打开一次设置页确认。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` 已加入 peer 集合（可选）：存在时用于状态文件的原子写与跨进程文件锁。

```
/flowus login
```

1. 插件在本机 `127.0.0.1:42813/callback` 建立一次性回调监听；
2. 打开默认浏览器至 FlowUs 授权页；若无法自动打开，命令输出与设置页均会显示完整授权 URL；
3. 用户在 FlowUs 页面确认授权后，浏览器重定向至回调地址；
4. 插件以授权码与 PKCE verifier 换取令牌，随后连接 MCP 服务器、发现工具并完成注册；
5. 命令返回已注册的工具数量。

授权完成后可直接以自然语言向 Agent 提出 FlowUs 相关任务。

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/flowus` 或 `/flowus status` | 显示授权状态、连接状态、凭据文件路径与已注册工具列表 |
| `/flowus login` | 打开浏览器完成授权，并同步工具列表 |
| `/flowus logout` | 删除令牌，保留动态客户端注册（避免重复注册触发限流） |
| `/flowus tools` | 列出已注册至模型侧的 FlowUs 工具 |
| `/flowus call <工具> [JSON]` | 直接调用指定工具，例如 `/flowus call search_pages {"query":"周报"}` |
| `/flowus reload` | 重新连接并同步工具列表 |
| `/flowus help` | 显示用法 |

插件通过 `settings.section` 槽位（`id: flowus`）向设置面板贡献一个独立页面，用于查看状态并执行授权相关操作：

- **状态指示**：未授权、等待浏览器授权、已授权未连接、已连接（含工具数量）四种状态，使用 `StateDot` 与 `Tag` 呈现。
- **状态明细**：MCP 地址、工具命名空间、凭据文件路径、授权 scope、令牌过期时间、是否包含刷新令牌、上次同步时间、最近错误。
- **操作按钮**：登录（未授权时）、重新授权（已授权时）、取消（授权进行中）、重新连接、退出登录、刷新。
- **工具列表**：当前注册至模型侧的 `mcp__flowus__*` 工具及其简述。

页面数据来自宿主路由 `GET /flowus/api/status`；按钮分别向 `/flowus/api/login`、`/flowus/api/login-cancel`、`/flowus/api/logout`、`/flowus/api/reload` 发送 POST 请求。全部响应均为同一份状态快照（`{ ok, snapshot }`），因此单一渲染路径即可覆盖所有操作。

上述路由与 DSH 其他 Web 接口一致，先经由连接服务的信任栅栏（Host/Origin 校验与登录令牌 Cookie）：未认证请求直接返回 401，无法读取状态或触发授权。

授权采用先返回后轮询的方式：`POST /flowus/api/login` 立即返回，浏览器授权在后台执行（上限为 `loginTimeoutMs`）；页面在等待期间每 1.5 秒刷新一次状态，因此不会长时间占用 HTTP 请求。

配置通过 profile 补丁层覆盖（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: flowus
  config:
    callbackPort: 42813
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serverUrl` | `https://mcp.flowus.cn/message` | FlowUs MCP 资源地址 |
| `serverName` | `flowus` | 工具命名空间（`mcp__<serverName>__*`） |
| `scope` | `all` | 请求的 OAuth scope（FlowUs 公布 `all`） |
| `autoConnect` | `true` | 启动时若已有可用令牌，则连接并发布工具 |
| `failOnStartupError` | `false` | 初始连接或工具同步失败时，是否使插件激活失败 |
| `statePath` | 空 → `<DSH_HOME>/flowus/oauth.json` | 凭据与注册信息文件路径 |
| `clientName` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 授权页显示的客户端名称 |
| `callbackHost` | `127.0.0.1` | 回调监听地址 |
| `callbackPort` | `42813` | 回调端口（固定端口可复用同一次客户端注册） |
| `callbackPath` | `/callback` | 回调路径 |
| `loginTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 等待浏览器完成授权的上限 |
| `openBrowser` | `true` | 是否自动打开默认浏览器 |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次工具调用超时 |
| `maxTools` | `128` | 发布工具的数量上限（`0` 表示不限制） |
| `maxResultChars` | `32000` | 单次工具结果转发给模型的字符上限，超出时保留首尾并注明省略量（`0` 表示不限制） |
| `deferToolLoading` | `false` | 以「延迟加载」发布 FlowUs 工具：在支持该能力的路由上，schema 以 `defer_loading` 声明而不进入常驻上下文；不支持的路由会自动忽略该标记 |
| `maxInstructionChars` | `32000` | 服务器 instructions 进入系统提示词前的字符上限，超出部分截断并在日志中提示（`0` 表示不限制） |
| `promptSection` | `true` | 是否将 FlowUs 说明与服务器 instructions 并入系统提示词 |

- 凭据文件位于 `%DSH_HOME%\flowus\oauth.json`（默认 `C:\Users\<用户名>\.dsh\flowus\oauth.json`），内容包括动态注册的 `client_id`、令牌集合、PKCE verifier 与 discovery 缓存。写入优先使用宿主提供的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write`（随机后缀 + `wx` 独占创建 + rename，并以文件锁串行化跨进程的读-改-写；该 peer 声明为可选，缺失时回退到等价的本地实现），权限按平台能力设置为 `0600`。登出会顺带清理残留的 `<file>.*.tmp` 与 `<file>.corrupt`。
- 客户端类型为 public client：`token_endpoint_auth_method = "none"`，配合 PKCE S256，不存在 client secret；刷新令牌是唯一的长期凭据。
- `logout` 仅清除令牌与 verifier，保留动态客户端注册。注册端点限流较严格（实测响应头 `X-RateLimit-Limit: 3`），复用注册可避免重复登录时触发限流。
- 涉及的网络端点：`mcp.flowus.cn`（资源元数据与 MCP 数据面）、`api.flowus.cn`（授权、令牌、注册）。
- 撤销授权：先在 FlowUs 侧撤销该应用授权，再于本地执行 `/flowus logout`。

```
/flowus login
  ├─ 建立 127.0.0.1:42813/callback 一次性监听（先生成 state）
  ├─ auth(provider, { serverUrl, scope })          ← 由 MCP SDK 驱动
  │    ├─ RFC 9728 发现  /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

- **令牌续期。** 运行时收到 401 时，SDK 使用刷新令牌续期并重试一次；仍失败则以“需要重新授权”的明确错误报告。插件记录令牌的获取时间与有效期，在连接前若判定已过期即先行刷新，以避免首次请求即返回 401。
- **工具列表变更。** MCP 的 `notifications/tools/list_changed` 触发重新同步：插件接管新列表并以整代替换重新注册，失败时保留上一代。
- **会话自愈。** 服务器遗忘会话时（JSON-RPC `-32001`，或会话端点 404），插件自动重连一次、重新注册工具列表并重放当前调用，无需人工执行 `/flowus reload`。
- **瞬时故障退避。** `mcp.flowus.cn` 前面的 nginx 会给出秒级的 503 窗口（实测：所有 MCP 端点同时 503，8 秒后恢复正常）。这类网关拒绝会以指数退避 + 抖动重放（最多 3 次，500ms 起、8s 封顶）；可能已被处理的模糊失败（500/429/连接重置）只对只读工具重放，写操作永不因插件自身重试而重复执行。同步失败后还会自动补试（5s / 15s / 60s），与 DSH 自带 MCP 桥的重连行为一致。
- **错误脱敏。** SDK 会把响应正文整段塞进错误信息，因此对外（状态快照、设置页、`/flowus status`、模型看到的工具错误）只给出一句短文本：已知状态码转成人话、剥掉标记、压掉空白并截断到 200 字符，网关 HTML 原文只进日志。快照另带 `lastErrorKind`，设置页与 `/flowus status` 会标明「暂时性，插件会自动重试」。
- **结果上界与调用卡片。** 单个结果转发给模型前按 `maxResultChars` 截断：保留首尾并注明省略了多少字符，结构化内容同样受限，超大内联负载（base64 图片/blob）在保存的原始块中以大小占位。每个工具还提供调用卡片：`kind` 区分读取/搜索与写入，标题给出本次调用的对象。
- **调用串行化。** FlowUs 服务端限制同一 MCP 会话同时仅允许一个工具调用（并发调用返回 JSON-RPC `-32002`）。插件在会话内以串行队列执行调用，并对并发拒绝执行有限次退避重试，因此模型并行发起多个只读调用不会失败（验证结果：5 个并发调用全部成功）。
- **命名冲突。** 若 `mcp__flowus__*` 已被其他插件占用，则该次同步整体拒绝，不产生部分发布。
- **回调校验。** 回调监听只接受 `GET`，并要求唯一且匹配的 `state`（常量时间比较）；不满足者只作答、不结束登录，因此本机任意进程或页面无法取消进行中的授权。监听地址强制为 loopback（RFC 8252 §7.3），帮助页回显的服务器

本地开发从锁文件安装，再把一份 DSH 运行时链接进来（`node_modules` 不入库）：

```powershell
npm ci --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps                    # 按锁文件安装（含 typescript / @types/node）
npm install --no-save --no-package-lock --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2
npm run link-runtime                                          # 逐包软链到上面这份运行时

> **链接方式与顺序。** `scripts/link-runtime-packages.mjs` 为每个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包各建一条软链（Windows 用 junction），而不是把整个 scope 目录链成一个。实测差别：`npm install` 会删掉逐包软链本身、但**保留**其指向的真实包；整目录 junction 则会让 npm 穿过链接删掉运行时里的包（本仓库被这样毁过一次）。顺序上仍是**先跑完所有 npm 命令、再链接**；链接之后任何 npm/pnpm 命令都要重跑 `npm run link-runtime`。

测试构成：

| 文件 | 覆盖范围 |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/tool-names.test.js` | 工具命名契约（与官方 MCP 桥一致） |
| `tests/command-grammar.test.js` | `/flowus` 语法解析 |
| `tests/store.test.js` | 状态文件的原子写入（宿主原语与本地回退）、跨实例串行、损坏隔离与残留清理 |
| `tests/oauth-provider.test.js` | `OAuthClientProvider` 语义、issuer 绑定（凭据不跨授权服务器出示）与状态裁剪 |
| `tests/callback-server.test.js` | 回调校验（state、code、error、端口回退、abort） |
| `tests/login.test.js` | 两条腿的授权交换（注入 `authImpl`，不触网）：成功、已授权短路、无授权 URL、未完成交换、浏览器关闭、取消、超时、redirect 变更失效 |
| `tests/browser.test.js` | 不依赖 shell 的浏览器启动与候选回退 |
| `tests/tool-bridge.test.js` | MCP JSON Schema 至 DSH 参数 DSL 的转换与输出契约（以 DSH 自身的 schema 编译器校验） |

A FlowUs integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The plugin performs OAuth 2.1 authorization against the official FlowUs MCP server (`https://mcp.flowus.cn/message`) entirely within the host process — RFC 9728 metadata discovery, RFC 7591 dynamic client registration and PKCE S256 — registers the tools published by that server as native agent tools, and provides a `/flowus` command together with a settings-panel page. The authorization flow does not use a static token.

- **Browser authorization.** An OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow against the official FlowUs MCP server, with a loopback callback listener on `127.0.0.1`. Access and refresh tokens are stored in a plugin-private state file and renewed automatically.
- **Native tools.** Every tool published by the FlowUs MCP server is registered with the DSH tool registry under the same naming convention as the stock MCP bridge, namely `mcp__flowus__<tool>`.
- **`/flowus` command.** Status reporting, authorization, sign-out, tool listing, direct invocation, reconnection and help.
- **Settings page.** A dedicated FlowUs page in the settings panel: authorization and connection state, the server version, the tool catalogue (searchable by name or description, each entry labelled read-only or write), and the authorization, reconnection, sign-out and refresh actions. The credential path and the authorization URL can be copied with one click, the page polls while a browser login is pending, and it refreshes immediately when the tab regains focus.
- **System-prompt section.** The server instructions and the current tool catalogue are contributed to the system prompt, with explicit guidance when the workspa

The DSH package `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` supports `stdio` and `streamable-http` with static request headers, but not MCP OAuth. The official FlowUs MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 and requires a client that cannot complete the authorization flow to report that condition rather than fall back to a static token. This plugin implements the OAuth client flow and bridges the discovered tools onto `ctx.tools`.

This release supports DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.1` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, and no other versions. The peer dependencies and the compatibility record name exactly those three releases.

| DSH release | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | `~4.0.4` | `~3.18.4` |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | `~4.0.5-alpha.1` | `~3.18.5-alpha.1` |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2` | `~4.0.5-alpha.1` | `~3.18.5-alpha.1` |

The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer dependencies use one exact-version disjunction, `0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-alpha.1 || 0.2.1-alpha.2`, while `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` use the paired ranges `~4.0.4 || ~4.0.5-alpha.1` and `~3.18.4 || ~3.18.5-alpha.1`. Every `@deepseek-ai/*` package is provided by the active dsh profile and must not be added as a separate dependency.

The matrix above was established by measurement: the offline suite and the live smoke tests were executed against the packages shipped by each of the three runtimes, with no failures, and the named-export sets used by the plugin are identical across all three. The alpha range clauses are required rather than cosmetic: a prerelease version satisfies a range only when a comparator carries a prerelease identifier on the same `major.minor.patch`, so `~4.0.4` does not accept `4.0.5-alpha.1`, and `0.2.0-rc.2` does not accept `0.2.1-alpha.1`.
**Newer releases are measured but not claimed.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.3` and `alpha.4` are published; this plugin does not declare support yet:

- **The host half passes on alpha.3.** Against a complete alpha.3 runtime (609 packages, peer closure resolved) all 164 offline tests pass exactly as on `0.2.0-rc.2` (161 passed, 0 failed, 3 live skipped), and the alpha.3 pairings (`cordis@4.0.5-alpha.2`, `schemastery@3.18.5-alpha.2`, `dsh-tools@0.2.1-alpha.3`) already fall inside the declared `~` and exact-disjunction ranges, so no declaration needs to change.
- **The client half is unverified.** The alpha line no longer ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` as a runtime dependency package (it is absent from `node_modules\@deepseek-ai`), while the settings-page classic script `require`s that module id from the shell's table; the id still appears in the alpha.3 shell bundle, so the outcome is open. Claiming the release requires one real settings-page load on alpha.3.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` joined the peer set as an optional peer: when present it supplies the atomic state-file write and the cross-process writer lock.

1. The plugin opens a one-shot callback listener on `127.0.0.1:42813/callback`.
2. The default browser is opened on the FlowUs authorization page. If it cannot be opened automatically, the full authorization URL is printed by the command and shown on the settings page.
3. After the user approves the request, the browser is redirected to the callback address.
4. The plugin exchanges the authorization code together with the PKCE verifier for a token set, then connects to the MCP server, discovers the tools and registers them.
5. The command reports the number of registered tools.
Once authorization has completed, FlowUs tasks can be requested from the agent in plain language.

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/flowus` or `/flowus status` | Authorization state, connection state, credential-file path and the registered tool list |
| `/flowus login` | Browser authorization followed by a tool synchronization |
| `/flowus logout` | Deletes the tokens while keeping the dynamic client registration, which avoids the registration rate limit |
| `/flowus tools` | Lists the FlowUs tools registered for the model |
| `/flowus call <tool> [json]` | Invokes one tool directly, for example `/flowus call search_pages {"query":"weekly report"}` |
| `/flowus reload` | Reconnects and re-synchronizes the tool list |
| `/flowus help` | Usage |
The plugin contributes a dedicated page to the settings panel through the `settings.section` slot (`id: flowus`). The page reports state and performs the authorization-related operations:

- **State indicator.** Not authorized, waiting for the browser, authorized but not connected, or connected (with the tool count), rendered with `StateDot` and `Tag`.
- **State details.** MCP endpoint, tool namespace, credential-file path, granted scope, token expiry, whether a refresh token is stored, last synchronization time and the most recent error.
- **Actions.** Sign in (when unauthorized), re-authorize (when authorized), cancel (while an authorization is in progress), reconnect, sign out and refresh.
- **Tool list.** The `mcp__flowus__*` tools currently registered for the model, with their short descriptions.

Page data is read from the host route `GET /flowus/api/status`; the buttons post to `/flowus/api/login`, `/flowus/api/login-cancel`, `/flowus/api/logout` and `/flowus/api/reload` respectively. Every response carries the same status snapshot (`{ ok, snapshot }`), so a single rendering path covers all operations.

These routes behave like every other DSH web surface: each request first passes the connection service's trust fence (Host/Origin validation and the login-token cookie). An unauthenticated request receives 401 and can neither read state nor start an authorization.

Authorization uses a start-then-poll pattern: `POST /flowus/api/login` returns immediately while the browser flow runs in the background, bounded by `loginTimeoutMs`; the page refreshes its status every 1.5 seconds while waiting, so no HTTP request is held open for an extended period.

Configuration is supplied by a profile patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: flowus
  config:
    callbackPort: 42813
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serverUrl` | `https://mcp.flowus.cn/message` | FlowUs MCP resource URL |
| `serverName` | `flowus` | Tool namespace (`mcp__<serverName>__*`) |
| `scope` | `all` | Requested OAuth scope (FlowUs publishes `all`) |
| `autoConnect` | `true` | Connect and publish tools at startup when a usable token exists |
| `failOnStartupError` | `false` | Whether a failed initial connection or tool synchronization fails plugin activation |
| `statePath` | empty → `<DSH_HOME>/flowus/oauth.json` | Credential and registration state file |
| `clientName` | `DeepSeek Harness` | Client name shown on the authorization page |
| `callbackHost` | `127.0.0.1` | Callback listener host |
| `callbackPort` | `42813` | Callback port; a fixed port allows one client registration to be reused |
| `callbackPath` | `/callback` | Callback path |
| `loginTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Upper bound for waiting on the browser |
| `openBrowser` | `true` | Whether to open the default browser automatically |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Timeout for a single tool call |
| `maxTools` | `128` | Upper bound on published tools (`0` disables the bound) |
| `maxResultChars` | `32000`

- The state file is located at `%DSH_HOME%\flowus\oauth.json` (by default `C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\flowus\oauth.json`) and contains the dynamically registered `client_id`, the token set, the PKCE verifier and the discovery cache. Writes prefer the harness primitives (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write`: random-suffix sibling, `wx` exclusive create and rename, with its file lock serializing a cross-process read-modify-write; the peer is declared optional, and the store falls back to an equivalent local implementation), and set permissions to `0600` where the platform supports it. Logout also prunes leftover `<file>.*.tmp` and `<file>.corrupt` siblings.
- The client is a public client: `token_endpoint_auth_method = "none"` together with PKCE S256, and no client secret exists. The refresh token is the only long-lived credential.
- `logout` removes the tokens and the verifier while retaining the dynamic client registration. The registration endpoint is rate-limited (an observed `X-RateLimit-Limit` of 3), so reusing the registration avoids throttling on subsequent sign-ins.
- Network endpoints in use: `mcp.flowus.cn` (resource metadata and the MCP data plane) and `api.flowus.cn` (authorization

```
/flowus login
  ├─ open a one-shot listener on 127.0.0.1:42813/callback (state generated first)
  ├─ auth(provider, { serverUrl, scope })          ← driven by the MCP SDK
  │    ├─ RFC 9728 discovery  /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

- **Token renewal.** On a runtime 401 the SDK refreshes the token with the stored refresh token and retries once; if the retry still fails, the plugin reports an explicit "re-authorization required" error. The plugin records the acquisition time and lifetime of the token set and refreshes before connecting when the access token is already stale, so the first request does not have to fail with 401.
- **Tool-list changes.** `notifications/tools/list_changed` triggers a re-synchronization: the plugin adopts the new list and re-registers the whole generation, keeping the previous one when a re-registration fails.
- **Session self-healing.** When the server has forgotten the session (JSON-RPC `-32001`, or a 404 from the session endpoint), the plugin reconnects once, re-registers the tool list and replays the call in flight, so no manual `/flowus reload` is required.
- **Transient-failure backoff.** The nginx in front of `mcp.flowus.cn` answers short 503 windows (measured: every MCP endpoint 503, healthy again eight seconds later). A gateway rejection is replayed with bounded exponential backoff and jitter (three retries, 500 ms base, 8 s cap); an ambiguous failure (500/429/reset) is rep

- Image and audio content blocks are not rendered inline; they are presented as placeholder text. FlowUs tools are predominantly text- and JSON-oriented.
- The MCP task extension is not supported: tools declaring `execution.taskSupport === "required"` are skipped and the reason is logged.
- MCP resources and prompts are not registered; the scope of this plugin is tools, the command and the settings page.
